articles.summary: A Michigan couple has lost a legal battle over a 50-foot-wide strip of land they claimed was wrongly excluded from their property because of an error in a 1965 deed. articles.title: Tyler Perry donated $750K to clear property tax debt for 300+ Atlanta seniors
articles.summary: Tyler Perry has made a significant donation of $750,000 to assist low-income senior citizens in Atlanta. This contribution will help more than 300 seniors pay overdue property taxes and remain in their homes.

articles.title: University of Glasgow develops £20 ultrasound device to produce fertiliser from air and water
articles.summary: Researchers at the University of Glasgow have developed an affordable ultrasound device to produce nitrate for agriculture. This device uses sound waves, air, and water to create nitrate without industrial production reliance.

articles.title: Stock market today: Sensex rebounds after 300-point jump; Nifty holds above 22,550
articles.summary: The rupee rebounded sharply from a record low level, gaining 91 paise to 95.80 against the US dollar in early trade on Monday, after the Reserve Bank of India stepped in with several measures to contain volatility in the currency exchange market. Indian shares are set to open higher on Monday after ending their longest weekly losing streak in 25 years on Friday, supported by a decline in oil prices amid hopes of a Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire and fresh currency-support measures announced by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

articles.title: Mirnaa Menon recalls health scare during 'Jailer 2' shoot
